title: Mini Golf
description: Putt your way around nine playful mini golf holes with walls, ramps and water. Get the ball in the cup in as few strokes as possible.
instructions: Drag back from the ball to aim and set the power, then let go.
Keyboard: Left and Right aim, hold Space for power, release to putt.
Avoid the water — it costs a stroke.
Try to finish each hole at or under par.
